subject: The secret feature I almost didn't build
preview_text: This changes how you'll use Fresh Start forever. You're getting the first look before anyone else.
body_paragraphs: I was up at 3AM last week, thinking about the one thing missing from Fresh Start. The one question I kept getting in my DMs that the app couldn't fully answer yet. It was driving me crazy.

I realized we were helping you heal from the past, but not enough with building the future. The 'what comes next' after the heartbreak starts to fade. So I called my dev friend at 4AM and said we need to build something new. Something that bridges the gap between 'getting over them' and 'becoming who you're meant to be.'

Next month, we're launching 'Future Self Journeys.' It's not just another journal prompt. It's a guided, week-by-week audio experience where you literally have conversations with the version of you that's already healed. You'll map out what that person cares about, how they spend their Saturdays, what makes them laugh now. It's the most personal feature we've ever built.

The beta is locked for now, but your current journal entries are already shaping it. Open the app today and write just one sentence in your journal about who you want to be in 6 months. That data helps us make 'Future Self Journeys' perfect for you when it drops. P.S. The first 100 people who journal this week get early access. No announcement, just a quiet unlock in your app.
